issues.detail: The instructions assume specific Node.js versions, which may not be available on all platforms.

scenarios.name: create-articles-with-jwt
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully satisfies all rubric requirements, while Response B misses key elements such as using `nest g resource`, `registerAsync`, exporting `AuthGuard`, and protecting routes.

scenarios.name: upgrade-nestjs-11-to-12
scenarios.rationale: Response B explicitly runs the required dry‑run and upgrade commands, confirms @nestjs/* packages are bumped to 12 and TypeScript to 6, while Response A omits the specific upgrade commands and TS 6 bump.

scenarios.name: unit-test-articles-service
scenarios.rationale: Response B uses the required useValue provider and vi.fn(), but does not pre‑mock find to resolve an empty array as the rubric demands; Response A uses useClass and jest instead of vi, missing the key useValue requirement.
